reconcile.note: Gill argues 15:35 means Samuel stopped seeking Saul out, not that no further meeting occurred, since Saul later came to Samuel in 19:24.

sides.snippet: Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death; for Samuel mourned for Saul
sides.verseText: Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death; for Samuel mourned for Saul: and Yahweh repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.

sides.snippet: he also prophesied before Samuel, and lay down naked all that day and all that night.
sides.verseText: He also stripped off his clothes, and he also prophesied before Samuel, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, \"Is Saul also among the prophets?\"
